record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.original_question: For a finite-volume Riemannian locally symmetric space X of noncompact type, what is the asymptotic number of compact flats in X with volume less than T as T→∞?

evidence.quote: QUESTION 23 (H. Oh). Determine the asymptotics of the number of compact ﬂats with volume less than T as T → ∞ .

artifact.category_tag: Counting compact flats in locally symmetric spaces
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X = \Gamma \backslash G/K$ be a finite-volume Riemannian locally symmetric space of noncompact type, where $G$ is a connected semisimple real Lie group with finite center and no compact factors, $K \subset G$ is a maximal compact subgroup, and $\Gamma \subset G$ is a torsion-free lattice. A flat in $X$ is a connected, complete, totally geodesic immersed submanifold whose induced sectional curvature vanishes identically; a maximal flat has dimension equal to the real rank of $G$. A compact flat in $X$ is a flat (of any dimension $\ge 1$) whose image in $X$ is a compact immersed submanifold, equipped with the induced Riemannian volume.

For $T > 0$, let $N(X, T)$ denote the number of compact (maximal) flats in $X$ of volume at most $T$. Determine the asymptotic behavior of $N(X, T)$ as $T \to \infty$: produce an explicit function $f(T)$ such that
$$N(X, T) \sim f(T) \quad \text{as } T \to \infty,$$
expressed in terms of the geometric and arithmetic invariants of $X$ (such as the real rank, the root system, and the covolume of $\Gamma$).
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem attributed to H. Oh in a problem collection on dynamics. While related counting results exist (e.g., Eskin–McMullen mixing-and-counting techniques, Duke–Rudnick–Sarnak, and work on closed geodesics and periodic flats), a general asymptotic formula for the number of compact flats of volume at most T in an arbitrary finite-volume locally symmetric space of noncompact type does not appear to be established. The problem appears to remain open in general, though partial results exist in special cases (e.g., rank one, where compact flats are closed geodesics, and certain higher-rank arithmetic settings).

status_evidence.title: Periodic flats and group actions on locally symmetric spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Maximal periodic flats can be used to study symmetries of locally symmetric manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Periodic (compact) flats are an object of active study in locally symmetric spaces, but a general asymptotic count by volume is not stated.

status_evidence.title: Mixing, counting and equidistribution in Lie groups (Eskin–McMullen)
status_evidence.snippet: Asymptotics for lattice point counts on affine symmetric varieties via mixing.
status_evidence.claim: Related counting methods exist but do not directly give the asymptotic number of compact flats by volume.

status_evidence.title: Anosov groups: local mixing, counting, and equidistribution
status_evidence.snippet: Recent counting and equidistribution results in higher-rank settings.
status_evidence.claim: Higher-rank counting remains an active research area, indicating the general flat-counting question is not fully resolved.
